text: Program Description 1. Traning Objectives Editor Note: The major also was awarded the international engineering certificate in 2019, demonstrating that the major is at a high level with international advance. This major aims to meet the needs of national modernization and regional economic and social development, cultivate applied senior professional and technical talents with all-round development of morality, intelligence, physique and beauty, who are competent for the design, construction, management, research, education, investment and development of various civil engineering projects, and have strong engineering quality, innovation awareness, practical ability, sustainable development potential and a certain international vision. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses listed below are not all the courses and they are only for reference. Theoretical mechanics, material mechanics, structural mechanics, soil mechanics, civil engineering drawing, civil engineering materials, concrete structure design, steel structure design, masonry structure design, foundation engineering design, building structure earthquake resistance, road survey design, subgrade and pavement engineering, bridge engineering, tunnel engineering, underground structure design, underground engineering disaster prevention and mitigation, civil engineering construction, surveying, housing architecture Project management, etc. 3. Employment Direction Editor Notes: Many of the gtaduates specializing in designing and exploring in civil engineering in Shandong Province graduated from the school. Graduates can engage in technical and management work in construction functional departments, infrastructure departments of enterprises and institutions, architectural or municipal engineering design institutes, scientific research institutes, construction enterprises, construction supervision and quality supervision departments, real estate companies, engineering cost consulting and investment institutions, and can apply for structural engineering, disaster prevention and mitigation and protection engineering, road and railway engineering, bridge and tunnel engineering, geotechnical engineering Graduate student in engineering mechanics and other related disciplines. You can get registered structural engineer, registered geotechnical engineer, registered constructor, registered supervisor and registered cost engineer. 4. Introduction of School of Civil Engineering Editor Notes: The school has become a training cradle for advanced talents with strong engineering practice capabilities in the economic construction, especially in the construction industry of Shandong Province. The School of Civil Engineering at Shandong Jianzhu University was founded in 1958, which primarily was the Department of Building Engineering at Shandong University of Architecture and Engineering. The School focuses its efforts on two bachelor disciplines, namely: civil engineering and urban underground space engineering, and a sub-discipline of civil engineering for internationally cooperative program. As of December 2021, the School has 149 employees, including 127 faculty members. The School currently has 2035 undergraduate students and 410 graduate students. It accepts 8 civil engineering classes, 2 urban underground space engineering classes and 3 classes of internationally cooperative program per year. 5.
